theme_and_archetype.description: Deep emerald/ink black with antique gold accents to convey a luxurious, trustworthy, and modern Indian legal tech aesthetic.

rules: Headings must use Cormorant Garamond with tracking-tight
Body text, UI elements, and chat content must use Outfit
Avoid pure white text, use #EAEAEA for primary readability
Markdown headings in AI responses must use the serif font

spacing_and_radius.spacing_scale: Tailwind default, use generous padding (p-6, p-8) for empty states

sidebar.behavior: Collapsible on mobile via hamburger menu
sections: Top: Brand 'JanNyaya' in Serif text, Gold Accent + 'New Chat' ghost button
Middle: Search bar with subtle #1A201E background, followed by Chat History list (grouped by time)
Bottom: Minimal user settings or 'Anonymous Session' indicator

chat_area.header: Sticky top with mobile sidebar toggle and current context title
chat_area.message_list: Scrollable area, centered max-w-3xl container for readability
chat_area.ai_message: Transparent background, left-aligned, avatar is a minimal gold scale icon
chat_area.user_message: Right-aligned, background #1A201E, rounded-2xl with border-bottom-right-radius smaller
chat_area.input_area: Fixed bottom, blurred glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0B0E]/80)

empty_state.icon: Large abstract scale or Lucide 'Scale' icon in gold
empty_state.heading: How can JanNyaya assist you today?
suggested_prompts: Explain the Indian Penal Code (IPC) Section 420.
What are my rights as a tenant in Mumbai?
Draft a consumer complaint for a defective product.
Summarize the latest Right to Information (RTI) guidelines.

micro_interactions.typing_indicator: Three small gold dots bouncing sequentially or 'JanNyaya is thinking...' with a gentle pulse animation
micro_interactions.message_appearance: Framer Motion: initial { opacity: 0, y: 10 } animate { opacity: 1, y: 0 }
micro_interactions.hover_effects: Sidebar items translate-x-1 on hover. Buttons have a subtle glow or brightness increase.

media_urls.usage_note: Can be used as a heavily darkened, low-opacity background for the empty state, or strictly rely on typography if the image distracts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY .js files for React components, NOT .tsx.
Implement the UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components (customized for the dark theme).
Configure tailwind.config.js with the custom colors provided in the design_system.
Import and apply Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' in index.css.
Install and use 'framer-motion' for staggered message appearances and typing indicators.
Ensure the sidebar is responsive (hidden behind a hamburger menu on mobile).
Use react-markdown for rendering AI responses, styling the typography properly with tailwind typography plugin or custom classes.
Set up a mockup or integration for file upload (PDF/images) showing small chips above the input box when a file is selected.
Include an 'Anonymous Session' note since there is no authentication in Phase 1.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF). Stick to the specified custom hex codes.
